{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Thermal base layer: fitted long-sleeve crew neck, hip length, soft grey #BDBDC2, fine merino wool

Refined knit: fitted turtleneck, hip length, ivory #F3EBDD, fine-gauge merino wool

Trousers: high-waisted, straight leg, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal #3A3D45, wool flannel

Coat: double-breasted, slightly fitted, below the knee, ruby red #B3202F, dense wool-cashmere blend

Socks: tall, cushioned, heather grey #8E8E93, merino wool

Ankle boots: low block heel, grippy rubber lug sole, black #1C1C1E, waterproof leather with a warm lining

Scarf: oversized, wrapped twice at the neck, mustard #D9A21B, wool-cashmere

Hat: close-fitting beanie with a folded cuff, charcoal #3A3D45, ribbed wool

Gloves: wrist length, black #1C1C1E, leather with a warm lining

Bag: structured tote with a top handle, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather

Why this outfit works: the ruby coat and mustard scarf stand out boldly against the snow, so you will be noticed on your walk and in the office. Underneath, the ivory knit and charcoal trousers are neat and calm, so the look still reads as polished office wear. The base layer, lined boots and wool layers keep you warm through a 20-minute walk in deep frost.
